name: ask-gallery
description: A "Questions only" mode: the open questions of every session full screen, one at a time, grouped by session, and next to each the session's text nearest to it, with your earlier answer when that answer started its turn
why: Go through the questions of all your sessions in a row, knowing what each one is about: answer, and the card flies up as the next one slides in; a session's questions done, the next session's follow; no questions left, and you are back in the hub
